stat: Share of AI-using UK SMEs that use AI to automate operations extensively, rather than lightly assist
method: Derived ratio of two published figures from the same survey (closest fit: Recipe B/C style aggregate cut, not a named recipe verbatim)

sources_used.title: Half of SMEs using AI, with limited headcount impact so far (Future of Work: AI in the Workplace survey)
sources_used.publisher: British Chambers of Commerce, with Atos and the University of Essex

workings: BCC/Atos survey (March 2026 wave) reports 54% of UK SMEs use AI in some form, and separately that 11% of SMEs use AI extensively to automate operations. 11 / 54 = 0.2037, approx 20%, i.e. roughly 1 in 5 AI-using SMEs are using AI for deep automation rather than lighter assistance. The source publishes both figures but never states the ratio between them.
